mutations.name: entry-world-at-seq
mutations.needle:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries middle second
mutations.replacement:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries
      { middle with world := cursor.world } second

mutations.name: entry-store-at-seq
mutations.needle:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries middle second
mutations.replacement:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries
      { middle with world := { middle.world with capabilities := cursor.world.capabilities } } second

mutations.name: reset-history-at-seq
mutations.needle:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries middle second
mutations.replacement:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries
      { middle with outputs := cursor.outputs } second

mutations.name: reset-index-at-seq
mutations.needle:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries middle second
mutations.replacement:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries
      { middle with nextIndex := cursor.nextIndex } second

mutations.name: clear-failure-at-seq
mutations.needle:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries middle second
mutations.replacement:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries
      { middle with failure := none } second

mutations.name: skip-second-child
mutations.needle:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries middle second
mutations.replacement:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    middle

mutations.name: reverse-child-order
mutations.needle:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor first
    runGroup cfg boundaries middle second
mutations.replacement:
let middle := runGroup cfg boundaries cursor second
    runGroup cfg boundaries middle first

mutations.name: zero-boundary-index
mutations.needle: | .step action => Composition.advance cfg boundaries cursor action
mutations.replacement: | .step action => Composition.advance cfg (fun _ ↦ boundaries 0) cursor action

mutations.name: omit-observed-ledger
mutations.needle: decide (∀ cell, left.world.state.balance cell = right.world.state.balance cell)
